notes.title: Version 1.1 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33464036/8e0e2e4582a9c78c0cdc7a98938dace30d68835f.png[/img]

Patch notes version 1.1

Features
[list]
[*] Skins added to the game. You can now customize your frog before you enter the arena.
[*] Street -level has been improved upon. Street now features timed gates that further encourage PvP -action
[*] Major optimization improvements. Game should now run much better on all devices.
[*] Round animations, score animations and general UX improvements.
[*] Menu system revamped to be more streamlined.
[/list]
Bug fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed sound effects volume being louder than intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween patch is live! 🎃
notes.content:
Besides seasonal decorations we present you with the complete overhaul of the “Street” -level. 
All changes made to Street are there to encourage combat and generally the kind of wacky action the game is great for. Street may receive further adjustments according to playtesting so be sure to let us know what you think of it either on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/921720/discussions/]steam forums[/url] or our [url=https://twitter.com/FrogOutGame]twitter[/url] 🐸


Patch notes version 1.02

Features
[list]
[*]Added season’s decoration to menu, maps and player models
[/list]

Street -level rework
[list]
[*]Map made overall much smaller 
[*]Cars now move slower
[*]The level resets position of all players to start whenever someone scores
[*]Added clearer indicators for finish line
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed losing menu functionality with controller due to mouse click interaction
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.01 is released!
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
 [list]
[*]Fixed game crashing when dropping in to water with tongue out
[*]Fixed player becoming invulnerable if eaten by another frog when hydraulic press comes down in factory level
[*]Fixed collision issues
[*]Fixed invincibility duration not displaying correctly
[*]Fixed being able to jump during eating
[/list]
Balance changes:
[list]
[*]Factory level now speeds up by 5% every time the hydraulic press comes down
[/list]
